text: {"name":"mfp_set_active","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Activates the MFP entry selected for a valid BSS context, records it as current, copies its associated data, and applies chip-specific setup.","subsystem":"mfp","var_renames":{"a1":"bss_context","v1":"mfp_state","v2":"bss_index","v3":"mfp_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"MFP state enable flag checked before activation."},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Destination buffer for copied configuration data in the MFP state."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Current MFP entry pointer stored in the MFP state."},{"offset":27,"meaning":"BSS-context byte that must not be 0xFF for activation."},{"offset":29,"meaning":"BSS-context lookup index; at the separate MFP-state base, this byte is set to status value 3."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"MFP entry flag that must be clear for activation."},{"offset":108,"meaning":"MFP entry flag that must be nonzero for activation."}]}
